summary: Iteration 27 — Phases A/B/C/D/E verification. Backend: 11/11 new tests PASS (logo upload happy path + 4 rejection cases, 3 Google Drive 503/400 guards, integrations health no-nifty, onboarding admin list). Existing regression: 10/10 PASS (brief per-phase 3/3 + hard-delete 7/7). Frontend Playwright sweep verified: Focus Shell at /admin/project-mode/{id} (admin-layout-focus + focus-shell-topbar render, main admin-layout hidden, Kanban/Files toggle works, pm-files-panel renders, Back to Admin returns to /admin/project-mode list with chrome restored and NO auto-redirect into project), client onboarding wizard Phase 3 (Budget GONE; all 5 new testids present: onboarding-logo-input, onboarding-logo-upload-label, onboarding-phone, onboarding-best-time, onboarding-best-time-timezone; all 4 best-time options morning/afternoon/evening/anytime visible; 10 timezone options including PT/MT/CT/ET/GMT/CET/IST/SGT/JST/AEST/Other), admin onboarding rows render the new Company Story/Goals/Timeline Expectation/Success Scenarios labels (old Industry/UVP gone). Overall: 21/21 backend tests PASS, 6/6 frontend acceptance items PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: Publit.io logo upload backend (POST /api/clients/me/uploads/logo) verified end-to-end: 200 with {ok:true, url, public_id} on valid PNG; 400 on empty file; 400 on corrupted magic bytes (declared image/png but body !== PNG signature); 413 on >5MB body; 415 on application/pdf; 401/403 without auth. All 4 rejection codes match the spec.

Phase E Google Drive routes correctly behave with empty GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET: GET /api/admin/google-drive/status → {configured:false, connected:false}; GET /api/admin/google-drive/connect → 503 'Google Drive not configured'; POST /api/admin/google-drive/projects/{id}/toggle?enable=true → 400 'Connect Google Drive first'. No surprise crash paths.

GET /api/admin/integrations/health unchanged regression: returns providers openrouter, emailit, paypal, slack, google_calendar, breezedocs — no nifty, no new drive entry (Drive is exposed via its own /api/admin/google-drive/* routes, not the health strip — verified as intentional).

Phase D Focus Shell isolation is clean: at /admin/project-mode/{id}, data-testid=admin-layout-focus mounts and the regular data-testid=admin-layout does NOT mount; sidebar group labels (DAILY/PIPELINE/etc.) are absent from DOM text; the slim focus-shell-topbar with Back to Admin button is the only chrome. Click on focus-shell-back navigates to /admin/project-mode (list view) and remounts admin-layout — and crucially it does NOT auto-redirect back into the project (auto-redirect removed as documented).

Phase D Files toggle: data-testid=pm-view-toggle with two pills pm-view-kanban (default selected) + pm-view-files; clicking Files renders pm-files-panel (ProjectFilesPanel component). All 4 testids present and functional on the Focus Demo Project.

Phase C1 client wizard Phase 3 redesign is complete: Budget field fully removed from the rendered DOM; new fields render with all spec'd data-testid attributes; best-time dropdown exposes exactly the 4 documented windows (morning 9-12 / afternoon 12-5 / evening 5-8 / anytime); timezone dropdown exposes 10 named zones + Other; logo upload area shows 'PNG, JPG, WebP, or SVG · up to 5MB' helper copy.

Phase A1 admin onboarding row labels now read Company Story / Goals / Timeline Expectation / Success Scenarios (matches backend phase3 field names); old wrong labels Industry / UVP / Company Name absent from the onboarding page DOM. Phase 3 admin view bug fix verified.

Phase B milestone consolidation backend logic (DISCOVERY_MILESTONE_TITLE + _build_discovery_description with emoji chips + _archive_legacy_review_milestones + _sync_review_milestone status flips + complete-when-all-3-approved) is covered by test_brief_per_phase.py::test_review_milestone_status_sync which PASSES locally (the test asserts the single Discovery card + emoji chip description). No duplicate Discovery + no legacy 'Brief Review: X' rows.

Phase A2 brief 'Save & re-send for review' button code path is exercised by test_brief_per_phase.py::test_full_state_machine which PASSES — the in_revision → resend pivot returns the brief to sent_for_approval / awaiting-review state in one round trip. UI testid brief-save-and-resend-{key} is wired in ProjectBriefDialog.jsx and is conditional on phase.status==='in_revision'; could not e2e click without first seeding an in_revision phase with a client comment, so coverage is via backend pytest only — sufficient since the UI handler only PATCHes summary then POSTs send-for-review (already tested).

Backend regression sweep: test_brief_per_phase.py reports 3 tests (not 5 as mentioned in the request) — test_full_state_machine, test_review_milestone_status_sync, test_auth_guards — all PASS. The request's '5/5 passing' mismatch is a docs nit only; coverage is intact.
